decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records the shared V system's move toward fully custom geometry.
A same-message MODIFY already fully records the accent's fully custom construction basis within the shared V geometry.
The source focuses the next work on the custom V system and already defers construction of the other letters; it does not necessarily change the E and L attributes.
The custom geometry change does not alter the wordmark's kerning goal, which is already deferred while the V system is developed.
Requesting black-and-white V studies for the current exploration phase does not cancel or modify the persistent champagne-gold finish requirement.
The V construction change does not alter the requirement to provide final production-ready artwork.
